title: PageSpec (design-repo: vault-clone)
description: Machine contract for one generated page composed from this design system. Custom keyword 'maxWords' is enforced by schema/semantic_validate.py (JSON Schema cannot count words); maxLength is a coarse backstop. There is deliberately NO per-instance style/token override field: styling is owned by section/component contracts.

href.$comment: Internal paths, in-page anchors, or example-domain placeholders only. Real third-party/brand URLs are bound at deploy time, never in a PageSpec.

placeholderRef.$comment: Asset refs are placeholders resolved by the deploying team; never a source-site path or URL.

motion.$comment: Global floor: every node's motion names a pattern and a reducedMotionFallback. Per-section definitions (motion.<section>) close the object and pin allowed values.
